calendar_gap_bootstrap_reconstruction.interpretation: Conditional descriptive sensitivity on nonempty resamples; no calibrated confidence claim.

episode_dependence_reconstruction.interpretation: Structural counts and descriptive resampling; neither maximum nonoverlap nor multiplicity bootstrap estimates a certified effective sample size.

independence.direct_oracle: Cartesian product of rebuilt source-feature neighbors, filtered by distinct names
independence.scope: Two real graph enumerations plus a synthetic distribution/factorization falsifier; source-label aggregation, dependence and power independently rebuilt. This is not a second enumeration of all 109344 producer-oracle assignments.

power_reconstruction.interpretation: Known-variance normal approximation using an unstable eleven-date sample SD as a planning scenario; not a release schedule, calibrated power guarantee, or prospective trading date target.
power_reconstruction.units: percentage points of paired daily H10 excess difference; independent date equivalents

strict_policy_support_qualification.meaning: An envelope over arbitrary hypothetical completions on unsupported dates. A uniform draw from an empty assignment set does not exist. Do not export this envelope as an identified bound for the strict full-cohort policy.
